local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15', '2026-06-16', '2026-06-17', '2026-06-18', '2026-06-19'}

-- Collect busy intervals per user per date
local availability = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  availability[uid] = {}
  for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = date})
    availability[uid][date] = r.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: convert HH:MM to minutes since midnight
local function to_minutes(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

-- Check if a user is free for [start_min, end_min) on a date
local function is_free(uid, date, start_min, end_min)
  local busy = availability[uid][date]
  for _, b in ipairs(busy) do
    local bstart = to_minutes(b.start)
    local bend = to_minutes(b['end'])
    -- overlap if bstart < end_min and bend > start_min
    if bstart < end_min and bend > start_min then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Possible start times: 09:00, 09:30, ..., 16:00 (so meeting ends by 17:00)
local starts = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  starts[#starts + 1] = m
end

local function fmt(m)
  return string.format('%02d:%02d', math.floor(m/60), m%60)
end

for _, date in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, start_min in ipairs(starts) do
    local end_min = start_min + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(uid, date, start_min, end_min) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local start_iso = date .. 'T' .. fmt(start_min) .. ':00Z'
      local end_iso = date .. 'T' .. fmt(end_min) .. ':00Z'
      return {start = start_iso, ['end'] = end_iso, users = user_ids, availability = availability}
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids, availability = availability}
